ticket.title: Rebuild the index and workspace rollup from ticket records
ticket.description:
index.sqlite and the workspace rollup project from ticket files. Rebuild reads tickets/*.json from the owning repository; the rollup reads every repository declared in the suite members list and every worktree reported by git worktree list, so an unmerged branch is visible to a view without being merged into truth. Two invariants: the projection is disposable, so deleting index.sqlite and rebuilding answers identically; and a task uuid found in two repositories is corruption reported with both paths, never merged, which is exactly how GB-79 diverged. task_edges gains target_ticket_key and target_repo, which the rollup drops today (index/schema.rs:68) although 106 of 123 edge events already carry them.

DONE 2026-11-08 (commit 0cad22b).

sync_all_members reads each source in the layout it uses: records replay from tickets/, legacy repositories are
read from their ledger, so both coexist during the SP-37 migration. Before this a records-mode member
contributed nothing, silently - an absent ledger reads as zero events, not as an error.

One task id in two sources is now refused with both names instead of merged. That is the GB-79 invariant made
enforceable at the only place that sees every source.

Still owed from this ticket's original scope: task_edges has no target_ticket_key / target_repo columns, so a
cross-repository edge renders as a bare uuid in the rollup. That is SP-38 and needs a schema change plus the
insert path.

Unblocks: SP-40's second refusal (epic closure with unresolved children, which needs the rollup to see
children in other repositories) and SP-37's migration (which needs a rollup that can read both layouts while it
runs).
acceptance_criteria: duplicate uuid across repositories fails loudly naming both files; deleting index.sqlite changes no answer; a member-only checkout builds a rollup of one member without error
